description: AP-P1 / H05 - the G (GPU), I (real editor UI) and Q (qualified/soak) cases the 'pr' profile carries so the uploaded results.json SHOWS them, honestly, as ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED with the missing prerequisite named. GitHub's windows-latest runners have no GPU, no interactive desktop session and no serial equipment, so a hosted run blocks every case here and passes none of them. On a machine that does have the capability (the GPU qualification runner) the same cases execute for real - nothing is faked either way.

cases.description: The 2D golden-image suite (CosmicRenderTests). Needs a real GL context AND a tree configured with -DCOSMIC_BUILD_RENDER_TESTS=ON; ci.yml provides neither, so this is blocked there and runs on the GPU runner.
L05: the real Starforge editor driven through 200 UI cycles. Needs a GPU and an interactive desktop session; 'editor-ui' is reported absent on every headless runner.

S01: the two-hour SF_Telem soak on a live stream (record/autosave/export, screen switches, a defined disconnect/reconnect sequence, final close). Requires real serial equipment, which this campaign reports absent by standing policy, so it is ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED in every automated profile and is only ever run by hand.
